title: Forbid Git Restore And Clarify Forbidden Modifying Git Commands
description: Make git restore forbidden and add explicit message to all forbidden modifying git commands because multiple developers and agents work concurrently in shared files.
summary: Expanded forbidden modifying git command coverage to all listed side-effect commands (add/restore/clean/rm/mv/commit/reset/revert/rebase/cherry-pick/merge/branch/switch/checkout/tag/push/pull/fetch/remote/init/clone/config plus stash) with shared concurrent-edit warning; updated hook blocking tests and pattern assertions.
